name: Morrowgrain to Feathermoon Stronghold
label: Quest
description: Morrowgrain to Feathermoon Stronghold: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. My research is progressing fairly well, but if you have five more Morrowgrain I'd be happy to take them off your hands. Well... Happy is a figurative term in this case; the more I am around them, the more uncomfortable I feel. Still, my research demands I buckle down and get through this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks friend; I'll just store these out of the way for the time being. While I don't command the resources that Staghelm does, I am able to give you a little something for your trouble. Anyway, who knows what will happen if Staghelm keeps getting Morrowgrain after Morrowgrain. There's something fishy going on, mark my words.
Remember that I'm always looking for more Morrowgrain. I'll take them in quantities of five at a time.
